title: Clancy Systems International
description: clancysystems.com Clancy Systems International is an American parking technology company founded in 1978 in Englewood, Colorado, with over 10,000 parking systems installed in more than 500 cities across the United States and Canada. With approximately 130 employees and estimated revenue of 25 to 50 million dollars, it provides pay stations, parking software, license plate recognition and smart city solutions. Its ParkEngine cloud platform handles real-time parking management, enforcement, permits and revenue analytics. The company offers solar-powered stations, ADA-compliant units and EV charging integration alongside mobile payment options. It is one of the oldest and largest parking technology providers in North America with 48 years of continuous operation. Services span installation, maintenance, 24/7 support and consulting for municipal and private parking operators.
